slots.name: Alabama duration
slots.sentence: Alabama last week said it would halt the enforcement of restrictions on use of red-dyed diesel for 120 days.

slots.name: Georgia suspension duration
slots.sentence: On Monday, Georgia suspended the state gasoline and diesel tax for 30 days and suspended weight restrictions on commercial vehicles to reduce the cost of transporting goods.

slots.name: Illinois tax increase
slots.sentence: The state's governor paused a 1.3-cent increase in the gasoline tax for six months this summer.

slots.name: Kentucky gasoline tax
slots.sentence: The state suspended its sales tax on gasoline.

slots.name: Michigan ethanol content
slots.sentence: The state's governor temporarily waived an environmental rule, allowing regional gasoline stations to sell cheaper, higher-vapor winter blends and E15, a gasoline blend containing up to 15% ethanol, through the summer.

slots.name: Ohio tax duration
slots.sentence: The state allowed highway-registered vehicles to use untaxed dyed diesel fuel without facing state fines or penalties.

slots.name: Oklahoma duration
slots.sentence: The state said it would provide penalty relief from prohibition on the highway use of red-dyed diesel fuel through the end of 2026.

slots.name: South Dakota weight increase
slots.sentence: The state suspended its gasoline and diesel tax for 90 days.

slots.name: South Dakota permit fee
slots.sentence: temporarily waived the $25 overweight trip permit fee.

slots.name: gasoline tax reduction
slots.sentence: In May, the governor signed an executive order reducing the gasoline tax by 10 cents, freezing any increases in gasoline taxes and any increases in motor vehicle property tax in 2027.

slots.name: tax enforcement pause duration
slots.sentence: The governor paused enforcement of all taxes, regulations, and fines levied on the use of red-dyed diesel in farm vehicles and in highway vehicles for 120 days.

slots.name: highway weight limit increase
slots.sentence: The state permitted farmers and haulers transporting crop, livestock, and other agricultural commodities to do so at up to 10% above standard highway weight limits and temporarily waived the $25 overweight trip permit fee.

slots.name: low-emission diesel regulation status
slots.sentence: suspended the state's low-emission diesel fuel regulations to reduce emissions of nitrogen oxides from diesel-powered motor vehicles and non-road equipment.
